name: spoke
description: SPOKE protocol monorepo — JSON Schema SSOT with generated TypeScript and Rust types
//: Cold-clone gate is `ci:typescript` (inlined superset of the ci.yml `typescript` job: `build:operations` precedes every typecheck that resolves @42ch/spoke-operations from dist/, then the demo typechecks + `test:demo`). The composite `typecheck` script is a warm-tree helper only.

scripts.verify-codegen: pnpm run codegen && node tooling/codegen/assert-schema-count.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- packages/spoke-schemas/src/generated crates/spoke-schemas/src/generated
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-schemas typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-operations typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-connect typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-server typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-client typecheck
scripts.ci:typescript: pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-schemas typecheck && pnpm run build:schema && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-operations typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:operations && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:fixtures && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-connect typecheck && pnpm run test:connect-ts && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-connect build && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-connect test:dist && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-server typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-client typecheck && pnpm run test:demo
